bagPolicy.summary: Expect your bag to be inspected when you arrive. On busy nights, like sold-out shows, bag check may be mandatory.
prohibited: Professional camera gear without advance permission
bagPolicy.quote: please expect to have bag items inspected upon arrival at Elsewhere.

parking.summary: Street parking is generally available within a few blocks of Elsewhere, but public transit or rideshare is encouraged.
parking.quote: Street parking is generally available on streets within a few blocks of the venue,

rideshare.summary: Elsewhere encourages public transit and rideshare. The venue is about a 5-minute walk from the Jefferson St. L stop, and the nearest bus stop is Flushing Ave/Johnson Ave on the B57.
rideshare.quote: we encourage public transportation and ride-sharing.

concessions.summary: No outside drinks of any kind are allowed. Empty reusable water bottles are welcome, and there are water refill stations inside.
concessions.quote: empty reusable water bottles are welcome as we have water refill stations available.

accessibility.summary: Elsewhere is fully wheelchair accessible, including the rooftop, though some elevator access needs a staff escort. Alert security at the entrance for help, or email info@elsewhere.club ahead of time to request reserved seating or other arrangements.
accessibility.quote: Elsewhere is fully wheelchair accessible (including the rooftop).

reEntry.summary: There is no re-entry at Elsewhere. All exits are final once you leave.
reEntry.quote: No, all exits are final when leaving Elsewhere.

ticketPickup.summary: There is no daytime box office, and tickets are sold through Eventbrite, so show a printed or phone ticket or use the Eventbrite app. Bring a valid, scannable US government-issued photo ID or a foreign passport, since other foreign IDs, photocopies and expired IDs aren't accepted. Events range from 16+ to 21+, and no one under the event's age limit gets in.
ticketPickup.quote: we require a valid scannable US Government-issued photo ID or foreign passport for entry to ALL Elsewhere events.

gates.summary: Elsewhere has two public entrances. Use the large courtyard entrance on the left side of the building for Zone One, The Loft or the Rooftop, and the narrower corridor entrance on the right for the Hall or full-venue parties. DJs start when doors open, and live music usually begins about 30 minutes later.
